languages.role: Official languages, land area, capital, region, subregion, and currencies (ISO 3166-1).

population.role: Population, GDP (USD millions), and timezones keyed by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2/alpha-3.

climate.role: Country-level climate zone and mean annual temperature (°C).

area.role: Total, land, and water area with derived land/water percentages (CIA World Factbook).
